name: task-management-system
description: Task Management System — Admin + Employee portals, SOD/EOD automation, attendance, leave, reports

scripts.db:setup: npm run -w server db:push && npm run -w server db:seed
scripts.build: npm run -w server build && npm run -w web build
scripts.vercel-build: npx prisma generate --schema server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run -w web build
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w server typecheck && npm run -w web typecheck
